sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Front-facing middle-aged man with receding slicked-back black hair and small side curls, separate dark eyebrows, neat black moustache and a small separate dark under-lip chin patch; taupe-brown broad-lapel suit with small round gold lapel emblem at lower screen-left, cream shirt with thin grey vertical stripes and brown tie. Restrained slight smile, tight bust against full mottled blue-grey painted backing, light screen-left.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Front-facing middle-aged man with receding slicked-back dark hair and separate brows, thin black moustache with pointed ends and otherwise clean chin; charcoal broad-lapel formal jacket with subtle vertical texture, white pointed-collar shirt and black bow tie, partly cropped pale-gold geometric badge at lower screen-right. Restrained slight smile, tight bust on full mottled blue-grey backing with light screen-left.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Front-facing serious middle-aged man with brown high side-parted wavy hair, separate dark eyebrows, black rectangular rounded-corner spectacles and neat thin dark moustache, clean chin; cream broad-lapel jacket with thin rust-red vertical stripes, white pointed shirt, burgundy tie and small pale blue-edged gold circular lapel emblem at lower screen-right. Tight bust, mottled blue-grey painted backing, light screen-left; tiny badge markings unresolved.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Front-facing middle-aged clean-shaven man with receding slicked-back dark hair and small side curls, separate eyebrows and thin round metal spectacles; dark knitted cardigan with broad striped ribbed shawl collar and cream geometric knitted rows over cream buttoned pointed-collar shirt. Restrained closed slight smile, tight bust against full mottled blue-grey painted backing, light screen-left.
